{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0 in biomarker_baseline)
# This is a common placeholder for missing data
sentinel_count = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()

# Check value counts for key categorical variables
arm_counts = trial_df['arm'].value_counts()
severity_counts = trial_df['severity'].value_counts()
sex_counts = trial_df['sex'].value_counts()

print('Missing values per column:')
print(missing_values)

print(f'\nNumber of rows with sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

print(f'\nArm distribution:\n{arm_counts}')
print(f'\nSeverity distribution:\n{severity_counts}')
print(f'\nSex distribution:\n{sex_counts}')"}
